description: Waterways Ireland Canal Polygons is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Waterways Ireland. This polygon dataset shows canals managed by Waterways Ireland. Waterways Ireland is one of six North/South Implementation Bodies established under the British-Irish Agreement of 1998. It is the cross-border navigational authority responsible for the management, maintenance, development and promotion of over 1000 km of inland navigable waterways, principally for recreational purposes. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Waterways Ireland. Its tags are canal, canal waterbodies, canal waterbody, canal wfd waterbody, environment. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
